findings.location: T014, T020, T025, dependency order, and ownership map (lines 41, 53, 64, 108-145)
findings.affected_requirement: FR-021 through FR-030, FR-054; Constitution V embedded-prompt requirement
findings.evidence: The accepted plan requires Prompts/pass1-code-logic-worker.v2.md to be an embedded Vulgata.Agents resource (plan.md:113-114; Constitution:157-158). T020 is the only task allowed to edit Vulgata.Agents.csproj, but T025 creates the prompt later and cannot edit the project file. The current project explicitly enumerates each embedded prompt (Vulgata.Agents.csproj:16-23). If T020 registers the future file, its GREEN build/tests cannot compile before T025 creates it; if it does not register it, T025 cannot satisfy the embedded-resource requirement within its write boundary. T014 introduces the dispatcher still earlier, so the task graph does not provide a compilable, externally loaded prompt ownership sequence.
findings.correction_outcome: Regenerate tasks so one dependency-ordered task owns both creation of the v2 prompt and its project-file embedding before any dispatcher/provider slice that requires it, or explicitly sequence shared prompt/project ownership across tasks without an intermediate broken build. Update the ownership and RED-to-GREEN maps accordingly; do not hardcode the prompt or broaden production scope.

findings.location: Phase 3 Independent test, T004/T005, T023, Dependency order, and Exact RED to GREEN ownership map (lines 23-24, 34, 56, 108-145)

findings.evidence: The Phase 3 summary reverses roles by naming implementation tasks T010/T012/T014/T016 as RED suites and test tasks T011/T013/T015 plus unrelated US2 T017 as GREEN. T005 is marked parallel even though it is the GREEN paired to T004 and the dependency rule forbids RED/GREEN parallelism. T023 appears in the declared parallel RED group but is not identified as RED or paired in the exact ownership map, while the nonbehavioral classification does not list it. The detailed task descriptions mostly preserve the intended order, but these conflicting signals make automated partitioning nondeterministic.
findings.correction_outcome: Correct the US1 independent-test task references, remove parallel markers from dependent GREEN work, and classify/pair T023 consistently as either an observed qualification RED with named GREEN owners or a post-GREEN qualification task with explicit dependencies. Keep all existing requirement coverage and shared-path serialization.
